title: The Albert clarinet, John Lewis's loan, and Gerald Kendrick's band
summary: He kept the 15-key Albert, borrowed a silver clarinet from John Lewis, rehearsed with Gilbert Young, then joined trumpeter Gerald Kendrick's band that played by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings
